scope: Track 1-only Human candidates and recorded engineering diagnostics; no hidden reference, official score or acceptance claim

camera_producer_methods: MoGe2 ViT-L per-frame point-map focal recovery; episode-local median

left.error_distribution_policy: Exclude episodes with zero held-out observations; any zero-valued placeholder in their source checks is not a measured zero error.

right.error_distribution_policy: Exclude episodes with zero held-out observations; any zero-valued placeholder in their source checks is not a measured zero error.

native_decoder_parity.source: Recorded source-bound native checks; this analysis did not decode models or read meshes

timing.interpretation: Main job wall includes resource contention and reuse verification. Precomputed pilot stages are not re-added to main-job wall; historical experiments/rejected attempts are excluded from current-attempt sums.

actual_method.body: Received SAM2.1 masks and MoGe2 pinhole estimates -> SAM3D Body -> fixed native MHR identity/scales -> per-frame native fitting
actual_method.hands: Independent MediaPipe image observations plus native finger/wrist fitting configured for 180 iterations and image/support-boundary candidate gates

limitations: Independent image diagnostics are agreement with generic detections, not reference-relative reconstruction accuracy or competition scores.
Per-episode image error distributions are not a pooled landmark error, and detection weights are binary reliability gates rather than probabilities or measured visibility.

Native decode parity establishes parameter/saved-geometry consistency on the previously recorded deterministic sample; it does not establish geometric accuracy. No new decode or mesh scan was performed.
Input metadata hashes and float32 camera bindings were checked here; source videos, individual input mask pixels and model weights were not rehashed/reloaded.
MoGe2 intrinsics and monocular Human depth/size remain estimates. Metric/shared Human-object scene scale and first-reference-frame scene alignment are unverified.
Object reconstruction/motion, stable 3D grasp contacts, penetration/float checks, complete official export and receiver quality acceptance are not supplied by this Human-only run.
The candidate hand refinement may improve held-out image agreement yet fail support-boundary motion guards; baseline fallback does not mean hands have been fixed.
HaMeR/HandFlow were not run; the licensed MANO dependency was unavailable in the verified local setup.
A shared shape/scales vector is used within each clip; no global identity optimization across videos is claimed.
